after: CB 2026-11-05: Capacity changed from 1,250 MMcf/d to 948,000 Dth/d. The 1,250 MMcf/d figure was an estimate in a Pipeline & Gas Journal article from June 2025, made when the first binding open season closed. Great Basin's project fact sheet from August 2026 says the project adds up to about 948,000 Dth/d. This is one source, so medium confidence.
